title: Auth invitation redirect remediation

root_cause.summary: Staff invitation generateLink used redirectTo with query string callback?next=/auth/accept-invitation..., which Sydney Auth redirect allowlist rejects. Auth then falls back to Site URL http://localhost:3000, so invitation emails that relied on Supabase action_link redirected users to localhost.

old_flow.email_link: Supabase action_link (/auth/v1/verify with redirect_to often localhost)

new_flow.callback: Continue gate → verifyOtp → save invitation continuation → /auth/accept-invitation
new_flow.accept: resolve invitation → accept membership/role → password if first-time → app

callback_handoff.mechanism: App-controlled next query on the emailed browser URL (not Auth redirectTo). getSafeAuthNextPath allows only /auth/* paths. Invitation token + flow carried in next=/auth/accept-invitation?token=...&flow=... and persisted to sessionStorage continuation.
callback_handoff.continue_gate: token_hash + type invite|magiclink|recovery require explicit Continue before verifyOtp (scanner-safe)

open_redirect_protection.next_param: getSafeAuthNextPath rejects protocol-relative, absolute URLs, non-/auth paths, javascript:
open_redirect_protection.assertStaffInvitationBrowserLink: rejects evil hosts, localhost, supabase verify URLs, next without accept-invitation token

accept_invitation_flow.membership_binding: POST accept uses invitation clinic/role only

security_regression.note: No AuthZ permission matrix reopen; invitation invite permission unchanged

web.note: Git-connected production Ready; CLI vercel --prod failed prebuild git ls-files (non-blocking)
